purpose: Read-only inventory of evidence required before independent PAY54 staging approval

controls.name: Independent release reviewer and approval enforcement
controls.acceptanceCriteria: GitHub environment settings demonstrate a named independent reviewer, prevent_self_review enabled, no bypass path, and a recorded approved change request.

controls.name: Verified Google Cloud project and billing
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Approved project ID and number, organisational ownership, billing linkage, region restrictions and immutable repository/owner IDs independently matched.

controls.name: Secret Manager access controls
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Approved secrets inventory and access policy, dedicated service identity, least-privilege grants, rotation/revocation process, and no secrets in source or CI logs.

controls.name: Budget and cost alerts
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Staging cost ceiling, billing budget and alert thresholds, named alert recipients and notification delivery independently verified.

controls.name: Private networking and egress security
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Documented ingress, private service access, outbound destination allowlist, DNS/TLS controls, application authentication and network test evidence.

controls.name: Signed container provenance
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Build provenance, SBOM, dependency and vulnerability review, signed image digest, approved registry image and immutable deployment reference verified.

controls.name: Formal cloud provisioning authorisation
controls.acceptanceCriteria: Signed release decision references the approved change, all previous controls verified, documented rollback plan, delegated authority and explicit provisioning scope.
